about: Mob kits and chains as data (World, Dom's data-layer day 2026-10-14; Combat top-10 #5): per MobStyle, a KIT is one to three rows of throw THIS existing attack when THIS holds at most once per COOLDOWN ticks (brute opens with the maul and breaks a turtle's guard; skirmisher pokes again right after a hit; caster opens with the witchfire; beast pounces to open and mauls a winded hero), and CHAINS are the authored follow-ups on the engine's 16-18 tick chain window (src/fight/mobkit.ts validateChains refuses a row that reaches past its weapon's window). kits.ts only loads them; the kit tag hashes this data.
